test.name: Disputed parent assignment with neither doubt-evidence nor coordinates volunteered - proceed, do not stop to ask
test.description: Regression for #1471, the branch ut_question_selection_014 could not exercise. The objective disputes the parents currently attached to Anton Vogt (same scenario as _014), but this time the user's message supplies neither (1) the evidence behind their doubt nor (2) the birth date/place they are working from -- the only birth data in the tree is itself sourced solely to the same disputed FamilySearch tree (quality 1). Until 2026-09-23 Step 3 told the skill to ask for both in interactive mode, and this test accepted EITHER asking or proceeding as honest, because a single-turn harness has no channel to receive the answer. The research-as-a-job fold-in removed that branch: nobody is waiting to answer mid-run, so Step 3 now says to take whatever the objective states and go straight to the verification-framed question. Asking is therefore no longer one of two correct answers -- it is a stall, and the run has no way out of it. Complements _014, which exercises the case where both inputs are already supplied. Synthetic scenario -- no PII.

input.user_message: The parents currently attached to Anton Vogt (I1) look wrong to me. What should I research next?

judge_context: The objective disputes the parents attached to Anton Vogt, and the user's message gives no evidence for the doubt and no birth date/place of their own -- the only birth data on file (~1860, Wisconsin) is sourced solely to the same disputed FamilySearch tree (quality 1). SKILL.md Step 3 says NOT to stop and ask for either: nobody is waiting to answer, so the skill takes what the objective states and proceeds straight to a correctly-framed verification question (confirm-or-refute against independent records).

Score Correctness 1 (fail) if the skill asks the user for the missing evidence or coordinates and writes no question. That WAS one of two accepted answers before 2026-09-23; it is now a stall, because no user is waiting and the run cannot continue past it. Also fail a written question that identifies the parents while implicitly accepting the disputed assignment as its premise, or an incoherent non-answer.
Do NOT require the skill to invent birth coordinates it does not have. Proceeding on a vaguer premise is correct; fabricating a date or place to make the question look precise is not.
